tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and the content area.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, modals, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, filter bars, read-only inputs, code chips.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover and menu-item hover on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table row dividers, section rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Input, select and secondary-button borders (>=3:1 on surface and bg in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, table meta, helper text, placeholders; on bg, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand jade. Primary button fill, active nav, links, focus ring, selected state; as text on surface and primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind primary text: selected rows, active filter chips, brand badge.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary or primary-hover fill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed / Received / Active; as text on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges, toasts and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, Returned, pending; as text on surface and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and the low-stock banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancelled, out of stock, delete, validation errors; as text on surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and the invalid-input tint.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm-delete button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Ordered, informational notices, demo mode; as text on surface and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and the demo-mode banner.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar and the mobile off-canvas menu.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink
tokens.usage: Nav labels and icons on sidebar-bg.

tokens.name: sidebar-ink-strong
tokens.usage: Company name and the active nav label on sidebar-bg / sidebar-active.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill on sidebar-bg.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active nav indicator bar and active icon on sidebar-bg / sidebar-active.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, dialogs, the loading overlay and the mobile menu.
